_doc: Default sys_sequence rows shipped by metadata-starter, as a template: this file does not load as it stands (its `_` keys are not models), so leave it out of the seed manifest. An app copies the rows it needs into a file of its own under data-tenant/ and lists that file in its seed-manifest.yml; seed-starter then runs it once in every tenant. The loader tracks each row by its `id`, the preId (sys_pre_data) — keep it equal to `code` to make matching trivial.
_warning: Do not mark that file `overwrite: true`: an overwrite file runs again in every tenant whenever it changes and rewrites its rows whole, reverting what the tenant's admin changed. Once released the file is not edited; a sequence added later goes in a new tenant file.
_never_seed_the_counter: Do NOT add `currentValue` / `lastResetKey` to a row below. They are runtime state, and create-or-update would rewind a live counter on every re-apply — the sequence then re-issues numbers already in use and the business insert dies on a duplicate key. A fresh row's NULL lastResetKey makes the first allocation take startValue, so leaving the counter out is also the correct first-time behaviour.
_convention: code must match `<ModelName>.<fieldName>` for SequenceProcessor auto-fill to activate. Other names are valid but will not trigger automatic field population.
